name: St Albans

council.name: St Albans City and District Council

licensing.selective: No selective licensing scheme: the council's enforcement policy (reviewed 2024) says it has not found a need for one.
licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: the council only requires the national mandatory licence, for HMOs with five or more people from two or more households, for up to five years.
licensing.fee: £207 per person with a minimum of £1,035 for an HMO licence

rent.text: £1,931 a month (ONS, August 2026), up 2.9% on a year earlier

price.text: £647,000 (UK HPI, July 2026, provisional), up 2.3% on a year earlier, the highest in the East of England

privateRentedShare.text: 16.3% of households rent privately (Census 2021), up from 13.6% in 2011

councilTax.text: £2,419 average Band D including Hertfordshire County Council, police and average parish precepts (2026/27)

neighbourhoods.name: St Albans city centre
neighbourhoods.housing: Medieval, Georgian and Victorian houses in the conservation areas, with flats near the City station and over shops.

neighbourhoods.name: Fleetville and Camp
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian and Edwardian terraces east of the centre, popular with young families and renters.

neighbourhoods.name: Marshalswick
neighbourhoods.housing: Mainly post-war and inter-war semi-detached and detached family houses.

neighbourhoods.name: Harpenden
neighbourhoods.housing: A commuter town of large Edwardian and inter-war houses, with flats near the station.

neighbourhoods.name: London Colney
neighbourhoods.housing: A village of post-war estates and newer housing south of St Albans.

neighbourhoods.name: Bricket Wood
neighbourhoods.housing: A village of inter-war and post-war houses and bungalows among woodland.

neighbourhoods.name: Redbourn
neighbourhoods.housing: A village of period cottages around the common and post-war estates.

neighbourhoods.name: Wheathampstead
neighbourhoods.housing: A village of timber-framed and brick cottages, with later houses on its edges.

neighbourhoods.name: How Wood and Park Street
neighbourhoods.housing: Post-war estates and semis along the Abbey Line railway.

housing: St Albans is one of the most expensive districts outside London, with fast trains into the capital from St Albans City and Harpenden. The city has a medieval and Georgian core, streets of Victorian and Edwardian terraces in Fleetville and around the stations, and inter-war and post-war suburbs. Harpenden has larger Edwardian and inter-war family houses. Private renting is below the national average and HMOs are few; most lets are flats and family houses for commuters.
checkinTips: Victorian and Edwardian terraces in Fleetville and near the stations: photograph sash or bay windows, chimney breasts, gardens and any damp in rear rooms.
Listed and conservation-area houses in the city centre: record original features such as fireplaces, shutters and old windows in detail, as repairs need consent.
Large family houses in Harpenden and Marshalswick: photograph gardens, hedges, garages and driveways, and agree what upkeep the tenant is expected to do.
Flats near St Albans City and Harpenden stations: note fob, key, parking permit and bike store counts, and the bin store arrangements.
Period cottages in Redbourn and Wheathampstead: photograph beams, low ceilings, damp on solid walls and any wood burner.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact St Albans City and District Council's Private Sector Housing Team, which can inspect homes and take action against landlords.
